ns2:section.sectionText: This course will prepare all students who are going abroad for a semester or academic year for their transition through a) examining expectations, b) focusing on the purpose and value of the abroad experience, c) preparing student culturally and logistically, d) addressing issues of culture shock, e) help students with articulating their experience for future personal and professional goals, f) enhance intercultural communication and global understanding, and g) assist with re-entry planning. It will be offered in a hybrid format. This course is a prerequisite for LAS 292, which will be taken while abroad.
